name: The Raven: Legacy of a Master Thief

locations.note: Constable Zellner boards the Orient Express guarding a ruby as it crosses the Swiss Alps.
The Raven's return is announced by a ruby stolen from the British Museum in 1964.
The chase ends at the Cairo Museum, where the second Sphinx ruby is displayed.
The chase ends in the Cairo museum where the two eyes of the Sphinx are to be displayed.
